title: rubus hevellicus
intro: Rubus hevellicus, commonly known as Hevel's raspberry, is a perennial plant in the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and support cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Rubus hevellicus include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may be attributed to the presence of bioactive constituents such as phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and anthocyanins.
